text:
Silver Price in 1991
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1991, the LBMA silver price rose 0.9% between 1991-01-31 ($3.83) and 1991-12-31 ($3.86). The highest sampled price was $4.45 in June and the lowest was $3.68 in February. The mean of these observations was $3.99. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
